summary: The protected snapshot-order helper coalesces full-state replacement requests and projects only supported sparse damage/destroy arms out of the coordinator delta, preserving legacy stream bytes and other ordered events. Complete replacement follows the delta when required. PublishSnapshotBeforeBasis records the exact emitted update only after build/serialization and enqueue succeed; failure grants no new basis. The owning source plan records controlled protobuf and coalescing/refusal tests while explicitly excluding a real engine manager walk, full plugin rebuild/loaded custody and native operation. Reuse the source invariant without relabeling controlled snapshots as original native evidence.
title: Grant a snapshot basis only after successful publication
